reviewer_role: bounded execution worker; NOT an author of ledger/citation_audit.csv and NOT a G-LIT owner
question: At the frozen L1 pin 315c19145065 (97 source rows) and companion L0 pin a1674f09 (62 theorem rows), does ledger/citation_audit.csv satisfy the decidable G-LIT acceptance axes (locator+resolution, class-token binding, cross-surface class/scope consistency, verification-status discipline, duplicate-cluster annotation, unresolved disclosure) as a full independent (non-author) verdict, with the ruling-bound axes (rubric HF-02 scope for multi-class rows; REC-6 exact_locator vs evidence_url) reported separately and NOT decided here?
method: One independently written stdlib-only checker (artifacts/worker-032/l1_full_review/check_l1_full_032.py). It does not import research_map/class_separation.py, any literature tool, or any prior scanner. All checks are total functions of the pinned files. Pins are re-measured at T0 and T1; any drift voids the verdict.

blocking_defects_pre_registered.B1: a class_mapping token that is neither one of the four frozen class ids nor the declared local annotation '(evidence/tag only)'
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B2: a row with no record anchor among doi/arxiv_id/url/evidence_url
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B3: a row whose resolver_result is in {unresolved, contradicted}, or whose verdict is 'verified' while status is not one of the verified-* values
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B4: a used_by_theorems or assessment theorem id that does not resolve in ledger/theorems.jsonl at the pinned hash
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B5: a row carrying class tokens whose referenced theorems' class_ids are disjoint from them
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B6: overstatement: status == verified-primary while evidence_type == metadata
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B7: a duplicate-component member whose mirror_of does not resolve inside its own identifier component (union over doi/arxiv_id/normalized title+year)
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B8: any pinned file hash drifting between T0 and T1
blocking_defects_pre_registered.B9: assessment ids not equal to used_by_theorems ids

verdict_rule: verdict = revise if any B1..B9 fires; verdict = accept if none fires. Non-blocking findings N1..N5 (below) are reported but do not change the verdict.

non_blocking_findings_pre_registered.N1: class_mapping = '(evidence/tag only)' rows: class scope recorded only through referenced theorems; the HF-02 scope reading is ruling-bound (BL-7-consolidated) and is REFERRED, not decided
non_blocking_findings_pre_registered.N2: exact_locator column quality and artifacts/literature/L0_L1_ACCEPTANCE.md:18: ruling-bound (REC-6 / BL-7); census reported, not re-adjudicated
non_blocking_findings_pre_registered.N3: self-certification share: rows whose reviewer is the ledger author
non_blocking_findings_pre_registered.N4: status/method naming asymmetry (e.g. verified-api with a primary-page-fetch method), which is under-claiming rather than over-claiming
non_blocking_findings_pre_registered.N5: weak predicates tested during calibration and REJECTED as non-defects: doi string absent from URL set, arXiv id absent from URL set, arXiv-year skew, bibkey-surname matching

controls.K0: unmodified clean row must pass all blocking checks
controls.K1: foreign class token must trip B1
controls.K2: row with all anchors blank must trip B2
controls.K3: row with resolver_result=unresolved must trip B3
controls.K4: row citing a nonexistent theorem id must trip B4
controls.K5: row whose class tokens are disjoint from referenced theorem class_ids must trip B5
controls.K6: verified-primary + metadata row must trip B6
controls.K7: component member with out-of-component mirror_of must trip B7
controls.K8: row with assessment != used_by_theorems must trip B9

falsifier: This review is falsified by: (i) any pinned file hash differing from the pin at read time (moving target); (ii) an independently re-run check_l1_full_032.py producing different per-check counts at the same pins; (iii) a row at the pinned hash that satisfies a pre-registered B-defect but is reported clean, or vice versa (control K0..K8 failing); (iv) evidence that a B-defect classification rests on a weak lexical predicate of the kind rejected in N5.
calibration_disclosure: Before this pre-registration, exploratory probes were run on the same pinned bytes to calibrate predicates (column value distributions; a naive first-author/bibkey match that produced 97/97 false positives; doi/arxiv-not-in-urls and arXiv-year-skew probes that produced legitimate-record false positives). Those probes are the basis for the N5 rejected-predicate list and are NOT counted as findings. No blocking check had been run to completion before this file was written.
